name: Dawn Rapier
description: A DAWN RAPIER: slender long ivory sword blade pointing UP, one broad gold center line, OPEN gold crescent knuckle guard with TWO large laurel leaves, peach-coral grip and round gold pommel. Elegant thin silhouette, no ornate tiny filigree.

name: Seraph Glaive
description: A SERAPH GLAIVE: long cobalt shaft and one large swept SILVER WING-SHAPED glaive blade at the top curving RIGHT, exactly THREE broad feather lobes making the blade, one gold collar. Upright spear-sized weapon, strong flowing wing profile, no loose feathers or magic trail.

name: Sun Maul
description: A SUN MAUL: an enormous round ivory disc head with thick golden rim and FOUR short broad blunt sun-ray tabs, mounted on a short ivory handle with broad gold grip. Upright round-headed ceremonial hammer, bright white circular center, no face, no many tiny sun rays.

name: Oath Bell
description: An OATH BELL melee mace: one huge heavy GOLD BELL-shaped striking head at the TOP, cream inset panel, wide flared lower bell lip and one small dark clapper visible; sturdy straight ivory-and-gold grip extends DOWN from its back-center mounting. Clearly a heavy bell on a handle, continuous mechanically joined silhouette. No rope, chain, sound waves or floating pieces.

name: Halo Bow
description: A HALO BOW: tall vertical bow formed by TWO large swept ivory feather wings around a central gold handgrip on the LEFT of the silhouette; one taut gold string connects the tips on the RIGHT. Gentle 3/4 side view, opening EMPTY, exactly three broad feather planes per wing. No arrow, hands, particles, halo floating nearby.

name: Judgment Trumpet
description: A JUDGMENT TRUMPET, a magical ranged weapon: one horizontal ivory-and-gold ceremonial horn with a narrow cobalt rear tube LEFT, huge flared golden bell RIGHT shaped with three broad sun-ray edges, one swept silver wing plate along its body and an unmistakable lower rear gold pistol-style handgrip. Big clean trumpet silhouette, NOT a rifle. No sound waves, beam or particles.

name: Wing Fan
description: A divine fighting fan made from THREE enormous overlapping rigid ivory feather blades, each with ONE pale-blue bevel and one rounded silver tip. They spread asymmetrically from a small plain gold hinge and an integral narrow navy handgrip below. Broad fan silhouette, no tiny feather barbs, gems or filigree.

name: Crescent Crook
description: A celestial crook: one enormous smooth silver crescent forms an open hook at top of a gently curved deep-blue shaft, with a plain ivory lower handgrip and one small flat warm-gold collar. Long moon-shaped hook with one sharp end and one blunt end. No stars, jewelry, face, glow or fine engraving.

name: Balance Maul
description: A divine judgment maul shaped as a simplified balance: a thick ivory crossbeam head carries TWO unequal solid gold circular weights fixed directly beneath its ends by short rigid navy bars; one short straight pale-blue handgrip continues below its center. Uneven broad T silhouette, solid connected weapon, no chains, fine scales, symbols or gems.

name: Cloud Cleaver
description: A solid divine cloud cleaver: broad ivory blade with THREE large rounded cloud lobes on the BACK edge, a continuous sharp pale-silver cutting edge on the RIGHT, one simple dark-blue bent grip below and a single gold rivet. It is rigid metal and enamel, not vapor. No mist, light rays, intricate curls or decorations.

name: Crown Breaker
description: A holy crown-shaped crusher: ONE massive low gold crown with THREE very large triangular points forms the impact head above a short ivory shaft and a wide dark-blue lower grip. The crown is plain solid metal with a single broad cream highlight, deliberately simple. No gemstones, tiny teeth, banners or engravings.

name: Oath Tablet
description: A divine battle tablet used as a cleaver: one tall thick rounded-top ivory stone slab, a dark-blue beveled right cutting edge, ONE large recessed pale-gold vertical panel with NO writing, and a wide oval handhold cut directly through the bottom of the slab. No separate wrapped handle. Heavy sacred-tablet silhouette, no runes, inscriptions, scrollwork or ornament.

name: Choir Organ
description: A small handheld celestial organ-cannon pointing horizontally RIGHT: THREE thick ivory organ pipes of clearly unequal length rest side-by-side in one compact dark-blue housing, a single pale-gold clamp joins them, and a curved coral-red pistol grip sits underneath the rear. THREE broad dark pipe openings, clean stepped pipe silhouette. No keys, musical notes, filigree, wings, beams or loose projectiles.
